title: node.find request
description: params of node.find: query, kind and limit, plus the owner and path filters.

query.description: Trimmed, case-insensitive substring of name, id, or a string-literal property value. Empty matches every node.

kind.description: Exact kind filter; an unknown kind matches nothing.

owner.description: Only nodes owned (transitively) by this page or component.

path.description: Only nodes whose authored declaration is in this file.
